text:
Alex Chen: heads-up — I paused the console analytics rollout. We have a contract erosion where the new telemetry schema drops route_profile_id for some low-traffic tenants, and downstream storage is rejecting inserts.
Maria Gonzalez: ugh. any logs or a query example? :eyes:
Alex Chen: yup, here's a failing insert from the shard batch job: `ERROR: null value in column "route_profile_id" violates not-null constraint` — happens for ~0.5% of rows in canary.
Li Zhang: is this from tiered quota enrichment or the new compact route attr write?
Alex Chen: compact route attr write. The schema change added a NOT NULL on route_profile_id because we assumed denorm step always ran. Canary discovered missing denorm for older tenants.
Neal Patel: so two options: backfill historical rows or relax the NOT NULL and handle missing at read time. Backfill looks costly but one-off. Relaxing might mask a data hole.
Maria Gonzalez: what's the impact on Console queries? p50/p95?
Alex Chen: console p95 for per-route dashboards jumped from 120ms to 420ms for affected tenants due to retries and increased error surface, plus failed writes causing alerts. Dashboard link: https://console.internal/dashboards/telemetry-contract (added to channel).
ops-bot: Canarian rollouts paused by @alexchen at 2025-11-02T14:04:10Z — reason: schema write errors.
Jessica Kim: product asks we show a clear “data gap” state in the dashboard for those tenants and block billing until we confirm backfill. We also need a migration timeline for customers.
Li Zhang: my vote is backfill + audit. We should run a targeted reingest job for only tenants with missing denorm rows. Steps: 1) identify affected tenant ids, 2) run idempotent reingest in k8s batch, 3) monitor telemetry metrics, 4) re-enable NOT NULL.
Neal Patel: agree but we need a safety net: add a temporary read-adapter that returns route_profile_id = 'unknown' (and logs) so console won't crash if we unpause the rollout early. That buys time for backfill.
Maria Gonzalez: who owns the backfill job? infra or eng-platform?
Alex Chen: eng-platform owns reingest logic, infra provides capacity. I can own the run if infra green-lights a small burst.
Jessica Kim: timeline ask from PM: can we have a customer-facing note by EOD and a rollback plan?
Alex Chen: yes — prepare note: "We discovered partial schema mismatch; rollout paused; running targeted repair; no customer data loss expected." I'll draft.
Li Zhang: technical checklist I'm proposing: `
- SELECT tenant_id FROM route_attrs WHERE route_profile_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000;
- spawn k8s Job reingest --tenants=<list> --dry-run=false
- monitor console.events.error_rate (alert if >2x baseline)
- once >99.9% fixed, reapply NOT NULL and resume rollout
`
Neal Patel: also add a feature-flag gate in the runtime: `feature.flags.compact-route-attr = off` so we can flip without redeploy.
ops-bot: infra-bot: request accepted — 4 extra worker nodes can be provisioned for 30m window upon approval.
Maria Gonzalez: can we avoid a full table scan? maybe do tenant-by-tenant windowed check using the routing index.
Alex Chen: will implement windowed scan + exponential backoff. I'll post the runbook steps in #eng-platform-runbooks after we confirm.
Jessica Kim: product: please tag the priority as P1 for the backfill and add customer comms to the shared doc.
Neal Patel: leaving a small TODO: add telemetry regression test in CI that runs a mini dual-write simulation for route attrs — prevent this in future.
Li Zhang: after backfill, let's add a CI check that validates denorm write count against ingest events within a threshold.
Alex Chen: ok — immediate actions: (1) I kick off tenant discovery (2) Li to provision burst nodes (3) Neal to sketch read-adapter PR (4) Jessica to draft customer note. Will update thread with progress.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks — keep the updates short here. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Job scheduled: tenant-discovery-run at 2025-11-02T14:10:00Z (owner: Alex Chen).
Alex Chen: update 14:27 — discovery found 87 tenants with missing route_profile_id, prepping reingest list. ETA for backfill run: 45m pending infra approval.
Neal Patel: PR for read-adapter opened: https://repo.internal/p/1234 — small shim that returns `"unknown"` and emits metric `route_profile_missing` for future audits.
Li Zhang: infra approved burst — starting node spin-up.
Jessica Kim: customer note drafted and sent to legal for quick review.
Alex Chen: reingest started 15:05. Monitoring shows error_rate falling back to baseline. Will post final status when done.
Maria Gonzalez: great work team.
